answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring a refundable deposit that scales with the trust an agent claims: a newcomer begins with a thin reputation, a single pearl, and must earn endorsements from established peers before handling large trades. Each endorsement is mirrored on a public ledger, so fake identities cannot hide their history, and a ring of sock-puppets endorsing each other forms a visible closed loop. Misbehavior slashes the deposit and penalizes endorsers too, making each fake identity costly — no sonnet of praise can waive that price.
